in vitro lymphocyte proliferative responses and cell markers do not correlate with clinical response to antithymocyte (ATG) globulin therapy.

in vitro immunologic function assays, such as lymphocyte proliferation and Ig production, do not predict clinical responses to antithymocyte therapy in aplastic anemia.
